newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan motorcycle exports up 0.8 pct yr/yr - JAMA.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan motorcycle exports up 0.8 pct yr/yr - JAMA.

text.p: Japan's motorcycle exports rose 0.8 percent in January from a year earlier to 121,778, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association (JAMA) said on Wednesday.
Overall exports rose in January after falling in December.

Exports to the European Union rose 19.3 percent from a year earlier to 53,247 in January, the fourth straight year-on-year gain. Exports to the United States rose 3.7 percent from a year earlier to 16,756 in January, the first year-on-year gain in five months.
But exports to Asia fell 29.2 percent from a year earlier to 23,949, down for a fourth consecutive month on a year-on-year basis.
